convert_tf_generator: convert a TensorFlow StyleGAN2 generator network pickle to a native PyTorch Generator module
convert_tf_discriminator: convert a TensorFlow StyleGAN2 discriminator network pickle to a native PyTorch Discriminator module
load_network_pkl: load a StyleGAN2 network pickle file and return G, D, and G_ema PyTorch modules
convert_network_pickle_cli: run the CLI to convert a legacy TensorFlow network pickle to native PyTorch format
force_fp16_conversion: force loaded StyleGAN2 generator and discriminator networks to use FP16 precision
